newsitem.title: USA: Tredegar Q3 share rises to $0.82 vs $0.50.
newsitem.headline: Tredegar Q3 share rises to $0.82 vs $0.50.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
Full company name is Tradegar Industries.

NOTE: The company said its third quarter 1996 included an after-tax gain of $1.2 million or $0.09 per share from the plastic films manufacturing site sale and an after-tax charge of $0.06 per share from writing off of excess film capacity. Third quarter 1995 included an after-tax gain of $451,000 due to non-recurring items. The first nine months of 1996 also included a net after-tax gain of $8.1 million or $0.62 per share for divestitures. Year-to-date 1995 results included a net after-tax gain of $41,000 for non-recurring items.
